verdict.rationale: Mem0 ships a hosted MCP server explicitly pitched as connecting 'any AI client' (Claude, Cursor, etc.) to the same memory store, backed by live runtime evidence of a working OAuth-protected MCP endpoint, plus named plugins for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex and 22 SDK integrations for other assistants/frameworks. missing for 10: explicit named ChatGPT integration evidence (only generic 'any AI client' claim), and independent hands-on confirmation that memory is actually shared/synced across multiple different assistants in practice.
